items.html: *Know that this light of the second head of Arich Anpin is also drawn and shines in this beard, which issues from the third head, namely the hidden Mocha (Mocha Stimaa). Therefore, corresponding to those thirteen locks, thirteen corrections of the beard came out here; for because of the great concealment, it could not be revealed in the organ itself, but only in the beard, in the secret of hairs, and it is revealed through them through narrow apertures.
